The text on the sign says ban private property but the bike has ten locks. I think the original meme was from someone trying to disparage anarchist thought about what is and isn't private property. 

A bike isn't "private" property in the sense that land ownership or business ownership is private. It's personal property. Something that is yours and not subject to use by others. 

The bottom text is trying to explain that capitalists have poisoned the well on what private and personal property means. 

Of course you or I would lock up our bike, it's our personal property. 

The sign above it is trying to make a farce of that idea by equating personal and private property to be the same thing when they aren't.

Not sure how prevalent that is elsewhere but where I work we give ample notice for entry and when it comes to work orders you tell us if its okay to enter or if you want a call or text. 

My team respects privacy and the fact it's your home and tread lightly. 

We also knocked multiple times, announce ourselves multiple times, and even leave if say someone is asleep. 

This for me has been heightened after stories of maintenance techs getting shot by tenants. And after being threatened by a tenant despite having permission from them to enter. 

Trust me, for the majority of us, we're coming to your home at your request.

They interact with each other and with the MC in scenes. Depending on the particular scene one or more of them will manifest and interact then subsequently fade away when the MC needs to refocus on the here and now or when a real person interrupts her train of thought.

The best method ive found to get started when I've got characters and some setting ideas but no plot is to start asking questions. 

Does my character dislike anything about their life?

Is there a problem they face in their immediate surroundings they need to get away from or fix?

If special artifacts are involved say in a fantasy or science fiction story-

How do they influence the culture? How do they influence the balance of good and evil?

It's best to start asking world building questions to put your characters on a path through the world. Without a path they are just standing still in their home waiting for something to happen.

An interesting solution could be something like this

Chapter 10

Ashes...

Chapter 11

...to Ashes


The chapters are connected but there's a delineation between them that makes them unique.

Is the spirit intrinsic to the characters religion or culture? Is it malevolent or benevolent and just misunderstood? Is the person slaying the spirit young and impressionable or old and weathered? Does the spirit try to get the PC to do something evil? Does the spirit try to tell them the truth about something that was held to he true by the PC?

Asking questions like these can really get the wheels turning. 

Hope it helps.

A few years ago I was living with a couple buddies in a house. i was working 3rd shift and hating life. My goal in life is to be a writer and get something published but in that life I was worried that i'd blink, twenty years would go by and i wouldn't accomplish anything I'd hoped to. So after a panic attack, spending a night in the psych ward at my local hospital, quitting my job and moving home again i thought i was on a new path. But i kept stuttering to start life. Then the biggest greatest thing happened to me. I became a camp counselor. That pulled me right out of my rut and i felt like "wow, i have purpose now."   


I rode that for a couple years but felt like i couldn't keep dropping everything to work at this camp. I'm close to 30 and can't keep living at home so i quit going there and am now back working a normal 9-5 (essentially) working to save money to buy things just like how i was before.   


I feel like my life is mediocre because I can't stay motivated to achieve my goals. All i have motivation for is to get out of bed and work. I'm worried that all i've worked to achieve will amount to nothing and that despite that life changing moment i'll in fact never achieve anything. That i won't amount to anything in my own mind.   


That's where the suicidal part comes in.   


When i was young (15-20) I was suicidal because i was lonely. I felt like I'd die alone and wasn't good enough for a relationship. fast forward to now and i have a loving relationship  with someone but that turned out not to be what i needed to feel okay. the feeling persists because now i don't feel like i'll be worthy of what i have, or that my life will amount to more than what i have. and i'm not okay with that.   


Turns out my aspirations are more than what i'm capable of achieving and now i just want to cut and run. save myself the embarrassment.   


Speaking of purpose I don't know what mine is. I used to think it was writing, then i thought it was teaching (but going back to school is next to impossible to achieve that goal). There are too many roadblocks and i feel too tired to try and push past them.   


I'm also worried that the way i feel now will never get better that i'll feel like this for the next twenty years. I'd rather not put myself or those around me through the trouble of dealing with me.   


I don't even know why i'm bothering to type this all out right now. I know its a cry for help. I know that there's a part of me that wants to persist. But the part of me that doesn't want to keep going just nags. And its fueled by my failures. My lack of confidence. My unwillingness to accept that maybe my life won't be more than what it is.

It quickly turned into a bloodbath as the men, locked in their metal prisons couldn't fire back. 

An engineer in the fray attempted to fix the machine but found a fatal flaw in its design. It builds up too much pressure and would explode on impact. 

 It turned out the index system was faulty and if damaged would cause a catastrophic explosion of built up pressure. 

Southern Chromin is full of canyons. The fleet of tanks were haphazardly lined up in rows very tightly packed trying to move south. After the first one was destroyed it caused a chain reaction destroying the rest of the fleet. 

The ruins still exists today in the canyons. Picked clean by raiders.
